svg.title: Bar chart of U.S. drug overdose deaths involving any opioid from 1999 to 2017, rising every year from 8,048 in 1999 to 18,515 in 2007 and 47,600 in 2017, with the steepest rise after 2014; lines for men and women show men at two to three times the women's count in every year, reaching about 32,000 men and 15,000 women in 2017.
